source_caption:
At the 71st Primetime Emmy Awards, Jodie Comer and Phoebe Waller-Bridge achieved a historic double-win for series created by Waller-Bridge. Jodie Comer won Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series for playing Villanelle in Killing Eve. Phoebe Waller-Bridge won Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series for playing the title role in Fleabag (which she also created and wrote).On that same night, Waller-Bridge also collected Emmy Awards for Outstanding Comedy Series and Outstanding Writing for a Comedy Series for Fleabag.
